name: Star Mint
summary: A save button that shatters its outline star and mints a spinning gold one in its place
about: A pill-shaped favourite button on a trail card. Saving squashes the pill, shatters the outline star, draws a gold minting ring and drops a new gold star in with a coin flip, a landing squash, a shine, sparkles and a card glow while the count rolls up. It works for likes, bookmarks and wishlists.
how: Hover: the star twists and a twinkle appears. Press: the pill squashes and the star shrinks.
The outline star pops up, spins and breaks into shards.
A gold ring draws around the slot, then a new gold star drops in with a coin flip and lands with a squash.
A shine sweeps the star, sparkles and tiny stars burst, the card glows and the label and count roll to Saved.
Press again to unsave: the gold star cools and shrinks, the outline springs back and the count rolls down.
